description: Na₂CeO₃ is Caswellsilverite-like structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four CeO₆ octahedra, edges with four CeO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 9-10°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.61 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four CeO₆ octahedra, edges with four CeO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-10°. There are two shorter (2.38 Å) and four longer (2.59 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the third Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra, edges with six NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with six CeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 10°. There are four shorter (2.47 Å) and two longer (2.49 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Ce⁴⁺ sites. In the first Ce⁴⁺ site, Ce⁴⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form CeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent CeO₆ octahedra, and edges with nine NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 9-10°. There are a spread of Ce-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.28 Å. In the second Ce⁴⁺ site, Ce⁴⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form CeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent CeO₆ octahedra, and edges with nine NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-10°. There are a spread of Ce-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.28 Å. There are three inequivalent O²⁻ sites. In the first O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to four Na¹⁺ and two Ce⁴⁺ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Ce₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-11°. In the second O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to four Na¹⁺ and two Ce⁴⁺ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Ce₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-7°. In the third O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to four Na¹⁺ and two Ce⁴⁺ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Ce₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-11°.
